data.headline: Experienced SDET (Python) | Expert in UI (Selenium/Playwright/Robot), API (PyTest/Postman) & ETL Automation | 2x AWS Certified
data.about:
Professional Summary:

•	AWS Certified with around 12+ Yrs of experience as Sr. SDET/Software QA Automation Engineer in different types of software testing, such as Unit tests, Integration tests, Functional tests, End-to-end tests, Acceptance testing, Performance testing, Smoke testing and Exploratory testing.
•	Expertise in Automating REST API Tests using Ruby (Unit-Test), Python (Pytest).
        Experience with SAST/DAST/SCA/IaC security scans
•	Expertise in Automating UI Tests using Playwright, Robot, Cypress, Selenium(Python) on Various Browsers (Chrome, Firefox, internet explorer and edge browser). Built and enhanced automated test framework using Cypress and Page Object Model concepts
•	Have implemented end to end UI automation to verify OTT application having various DRM solutions.
•	Experienced in load and performance testing tool such as JMeter (for On Prime Systems ) and Locust (for Cloud SaaS Applications)
•	Automated AWS infrastructures using boto3, AWS CLI, AWS CloudFormation and AWS CDK.
•	Automated Setting up Secure VPC infrastructure using AWS CDK
•	Automated Setting up AWS Data Pipeline using AWS CloudFormation.
•	Familiar with various AWS Services such as EC2, FARGATE, Lambda, VPC, Load Balancer, Stepfunctions, Lambda, API Gateway, SNS, SES
•	Extensively worked on CI/CD pipeline for code deployment by engaging different tools (Git, Jenkins, CodePipeline, Codefresh) in the process right from developer code check-in to Production deployment
•	Proficient in Python and have sound knowledge on OOP (Object Oriented Programming) concepts.
•	Excellent analytical, problem solving, communication and interpersonal skills along with a good attitude for learning.

projects.subtitle: Mar 2009 - Apr 2011

description.text:
Design and Development of Automated Test Equipment for LCA Levcon Air Data Computer.
Client: Bharat Electronics Ltd, Bangalore - India.
Project Duration: Apr 2009 – Mar 2010.

Details: The Automated Test Equipment for Air Data Computer is a system used to test the different modules of LADC (Levcon Air Data Computer).

Scope of Work: Simulation and Acquisition of Different types of Signals, Initialization of ADC, Accessing memories through SPIL link and Functional testing and validation of various circuits present in these modules.

Hardware Platforms: NI PXI 1045.

NI PXI Modules: NI-PXI-8186(Controller), NI-PXI-6704(Analog Output), NI-PXI-5421(Waveform Generator), NI-PXI-6509(Digital I/O), NI-PXI-6528(Isolated Digital I/O), NI-PXI-4070(61/2 DMM), NI-PXI-5122(Digitizer), NI-PXI-2532(Matrix Switch), NI-PXI-8431/4(Serial Interface)

Third Party PXI Modules: Pickering Programmable Resistor Card, SPIL Card, MIL 1553 Card, CCDL Card.
Software: LabVIEW 8.6 in Windows XP.

Add-On Modules and Toolkits: Modulation Toolkit for LabVIEW, LabVIEW Database Connectivity Toolkit, LabVIEW Report Generation Toolkit for Microsoft Office, LabVIEW Application Builder for Windows.

LabVIEW Architecture: State Machine Architecture.

Instrument I/O: NI VISA, NI GPIB

Team Size: 5

Role: Software Test Lead.

Contribution: Requirement Study, Software Design preparation, coding, unit and system testing, Database Connection and Report Generation, Preparation of Software Documents i.e. (SRS, SDD, STP, STR, VDD, ATP&ICD).
